subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw accept one same-model/profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The patch appears technically narrow and proven, but it deliberately changes compatibility-sensitive auth-provider and fallback timing that automation should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
options.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want ordinary assistant timeouts to retry once on the same model/profile before consuming fallback or auth rotation.

options.title: Restore previous fallback timing
options.body: Keep fallback-configured setups on the old immediate fallback/rotation path and narrow this PR to non-fallback timeout retry only.

options.title: Split session repair first
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the aborted-leaf transcript repair to land independently through the sibling session-state PR before deciding timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
recommendation.body: Merge this PR if maintainers want ordinary assistant timeouts to retry once on the same model/profile before consuming fallback or auth rotation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest recent history across the embedded runner and agent-loop surfaces affected by the policy choice.
